blocks.text: Origin / creation. Migrant peoples, Path societies, healers, traders, Old Sound traditions, and varied body communities formed plural councils in the Last City of Many Forms.
Identity / human status. Cyber-pet and little-people civic institutions.
Importance. They coordinated mixed districts, healing, markets, archives, Path schools, and law among bodies and languages that had diverged for generations.
Decline or dissolution. World fragmentation, maintenance failure, ecological pressure, and population dispersal broke the city’s common institutions.
Final status / surviving function. Councils dissolved. Portable laws, trade customs, refuge practices, and mixed Path traditions continued into Last Loops.
